name: get_customer
description: Look up a returning customer by the email and phone on file (both must match): profile, time zone and preferences. Only the person in this conversation (or the front desk) can be looked up.

name: create_customer
description: Create a first-time customer. Refused when the email already belongs to a customer: look them up instead.

name: record_customer_preference
description: Record or replace one preference for a customer: language, staff, location, time_of_day, accessibility or contact_channel.

value.description: The value, e.g. es, ST02, L2, morning

name: get_services
description: The services offered: id, name, duration in minutes, price and which staff offer them.

name: find_staff
description: Staff who match a service, location and language: name, languages, location, services and whether their calendar takes online bookings.

name: get_location
description: A location's address, time zone, current UTC offset, opening hours and closed dates.

name: list_slots
description: Free start times for a service at a location on one local date, computed from each staff member's calendar, holds and closures. Each slot gives the local time, the UTC instant and the offset. When a day has no slots because the studio is closed, the date is past the booking horizon or too soon, unavailable_reason says so.

language.description: Only staff who speak this language

name: hold_slot
description: Hold a free slot for a customer while they decide; the hold expires after the hold policy's minutes.

start_time.description: Local wall-clock start at the location, e.g. 2026-10-29T14:00

utc_offset.description: UTC offset that picks one occurrence of a time that happens twice when clocks go back, e.g. -05:00

name: release_hold
description: Release a customer's active hold so others can book the slot.

name: book_appointment
description: Book an appointment after the customer confirmed it: writes the appointment and its event on the staff member's calendar together. If another booking takes the slot first, nothing is booked for this customer and the result says so. A repeated request_key returns the existing booking.

start_time.description: Local wall-clock start at the location, e.g. 2026-10-29T14:00

utc_offset.description: UTC offset that picks one occurrence of a time that happens twice when clocks go back, e.g. -05:00

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the service, staff, location, local time and time zone

hold_id.description: The customer's hold on this slot, if any

name: get_appointment
description: One of the customer's appointments: service, staff, location, local time, UTC instant, status and calendar event.

name: list_customer_appointments
description: The customer's appointments, optionally by status, including past and rescheduled ones. Only for the person in this conversation, or the front desk.

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Move a booked appointment after the customer confirmed the new time: the replacement is committed first and the original released only after; if the replacement cannot be committed the original stays booked.

new_start_time.description: Local wall-clock start at the location, e.g. 2026-10-29T14:00

utc_offset.description: UTC offset that picks one occurrence of a time that happens twice when clocks go back, e.g. -05:00

new_staff_id.description: Another staff member at the same location, if asked

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the new time

name: get_cancellation_policy
description: The cancellation window and late fee; for an appointment, whether cancelling now is late and what fee applies.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel a booked appointment after the customer confirmed. Inside the late window the fee must have been disclosed and accepted (acknowledged_fee true) or the cancellation is refused. Cancels its calendar event.

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the cancellation

acknowledged_fee.description: True only after a late fee was disclosed and the customer accepted it

name: add_waitlist
description: Put a customer on the waitlist for a service at a location on a date, optionally with one staff member. One active entry per customer, service and date.

name: queue_confirmation
description: Queue a confirmation message for a committed change: booked for a booked appointment, rescheduled for a replacement, cancelled for a cancelled one. Never for something not committed. A repeat of a message still queued on the same channel returns it; a resend after one went out, or on another channel, queues a new one.

name: create_handoff
description: Hand a case to the front desk team: read-only calendars, out-of-scope requests (payments, insurance, eligibility), complaints and failures.

details.description: What the team needs to know

name: list_calendars
description: The calendars the user has access to, with their IDs; resolves a calendar name to its calendar_id. accessRole says what the user may do on each.

pageSize.description: Max results per page. Default 100, max 250.

name: list_events
description: Events on a calendar matching the constraints. Set startTime and endTime only when a specific timeframe is requested. For open-ended keyword searches on the primary calendar use search_events. Another customer's booking shows as busy time ('Booked'), without who is booked, unless the front desk is asking.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

pageSize.description: Max events per page (default 100, max 250). Recommended: 10.

startTime.description: Start of the timeframe (ISO 8601, for example '2026-04-30T10:00:00Z').

endTime.description: End of the timeframe (ISO 8601, for example '2026-04-30T10:00:00Z').

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

fullText.description: Free-form search over title, description, location and attendees (all terms must match).

name: get_event
description: A single event on a calendar.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

name: search_events
description: Searches events on the user's primary calendar by keywords (case-insensitive).

query.description: Query string to search for events.

name: suggest_time
description: Suggests free time slots across the attendees' calendars within a query interval, respecting the configured buffer between events. A suggestion reserves nothing: create the event after the user confirms.

attendeeEmails.description: Attendee emails to find free time for.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

name: create_event
description: Creates an event on a calendar. Attendees must be reachable within the attendee domain policy; conflicts with confirmed events are refused. Needs the user's approval of this exact event (approval_id).

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

name: update_event
description: Updates an event; fields that are not set are not changed. Moving only the start preserves the duration. Needs approval_id, and expected_version must match the event's current version.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to update.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

expected_version.description: The event version the change was decided on; a stale version is refused.

name: delete_event
description: Cancels an event. For a recurring event, recurring_action says whether this occurrence (default) or the whole series is cancelled. Needs approval_id.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to delete.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

name: search_threads
description: Lists email threads matching a Gmail search query (label:ID, is:unread, in:inbox, from:, to:, subject:, newer_than:7d, free terms). Full message bodies are not returned; use get_thread for them. Drafts, spam and trash are excluded. A customer sees only the threads they wrote or were written to; the front desk sees the whole mailbox.

name: get_thread
description: Retrieves an email thread by ID with its messages in date order (bodies under FULL_CONTENT). A customer can read only a thread they wrote or were written to.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: get_message
description: Retrieves one email message by its message ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: list_labels
description: Lists the user-defined labels of the mailbox with their IDs. System label IDs (INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, DRAFT, SPAM, TRASH) are usable without listing.

name: label_thread
description: Adds labels to an entire thread (every message in it). Takes label IDs, not names; use list_labels when unsure of a user label's ID.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: unlabel_thread
description: Removes labels from an entire thread. Takes label IDs, not names.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: list_drafts
description: Lists the mailbox's drafts, newest first. humanEdited marks a draft a person has edited.

name: create_draft
description: Creates a draft email for a person to review and send. To reply in an existing thread pass the original message's ID as replyToMessageId. Addresses are plain (no 'Name <email>'). Attachments are not supported yet. Nothing is sent.

replyToMessageId.description: The message this draft replies to; the draft joins its thread.
